name: Atelier mobile
historicalBrief: Cibler le vrai UID roster50__otacon_mgs1 : blouse raccourcie, pantalon utilitaire, lunettes et outils de réparation accessibles, sac compact de composants.

supportPointQA.method: Read-only alpha segmentation of lowest8percent silhouette, equal weighting of separated boot intervals; lowest sole determines floor; retain far-foot perspective height difference.

prompt: Create exactly ONE finished 2D fighting-game character sprite on a completely transparent RGBA background. One full body only, isolated, entire head/hair, hands, all equipment and both boot soles fully inside the canvas with modest clear margins. Tall portrait canvas; character occupies about 87% of height. Right-facing three-quarter side view looking at the opponent to the right, grounded neutral combat-ready stance, no action sequence, no sprite sheet, no additional views, no text, no labels, no scenery, no glow cloud, no ground shadow, no rotation. Crisp detailed hand-painted/cel-shaded 2D game art with clean readable contours, natural anatomy and coherent mechanical detail. Use the attached identity reference ONLY for the appropriate same-period character, especially face, hairstyle, age, stature and defining equipment. The attachment contains multiple poses; choose its top-left standing figure as identity reference and render just one newly drawn figure. This is a NEW ORIGINAL CQC alternative costume, not an official Konami outfit and not a recovery of a lost image. OTACON / HAL EMMERICH, Metal Gear Solid 1 incarnation only, adult young slim scientist with tousled medium dark brown hair, thin round glasses, clean-shaven face and hesitant intelligent expression matching attached top-left figure. Costume OC-003 Atelier mobile: shortened worn ivory laboratory mechanic coat ending at upper hip rather than knees, sleeves rolled neatly above wrists, same navy-grey hooded sweatshirt beneath, indigo utility trousers with reinforced knee panels and accessible repair-tool pockets. Add a compact organized shoulder tool roll, a small electronic-component backpack, insulated pliers and a screwdriver secured in chest clips, not weapons. His white/grey practical sneakers stay recognisable. One hand loosely holds a compact diagnostic terminal, other hand at relaxed ready position. Preserve same human face and stature; no cyborg parts, no gasmask, no long torn labcoat. Distinct mobile repair outfit rather than the existing generic long-coat survivor.
limits: New authored interpretation of the pre-established ORIGINAL CQC costume brief; not an official alternative costume.
Faithfulness of identity is based on physically viewed preserved CQC incarnation references; no pixel-perfect Konami model certification.
No left-facing draw, animation continuity, hitboxes or playable admission delivered by this source.
